label: practice2-cart-stopped
alert: Failing calls from load-generator: POST at 0.05 errors/s; Container cart is exited (exit code 0)
summary: The cart service container has exited with exit code 0, indicating a clean shutdown. This is causing the load-generator to fail when attempting to interact with the cart. Payment service errors are a separate, pre-existing issue.

root_cause.description: The cart service container has exited (exit code 0), causing it to stop processing requests. Logs indicate a clean shutdown was initiated.

evidence.explanation: The cart container is in an exited state with exit code 0, indicating a clean shutdown.
Logs confirm the cart service initiated a shutdown sequence.
The payment service is returning errors, but this is a separate issue (invalid token) and not the cause of the cart service exiting.

ruled_out: The payment service errors are unrelated to the cart service exit.
The product-catalog service is running, despite having a high restart count.

proposed_action.reason: The cart service has exited and needs to be restarted to restore functionality.

prevention: Investigate why the cart service is receiving shutdown signals or if there is a configuration issue causing it to exit. Check orchestration logs for external termination signals.
